Movies_and_TV:configuration.transition: final training transition; prefix excludes target

metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:scope: One final training transition per selected user; in-sample, fixed positive and one fixed uniform training-history-excluded negative. Historical repeats of the target are retained.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:features: Oldest interactions truncated; survivors right-aligned with left padding; baseline absolute slots 0..maxlen-1; final slot scored. BxD output requires explicit final_BD declaration.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_alignment: Mean off-diagonal normalized cosine of up to 2048 seed-42 sampled nonpadding embeddings, excluding zero norms. mapped_alignment=(cosine+1)/2; zero cosine maps to 0.5. Neither metric establishes collapse or recommendation diversity.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:intact: User means of fixed positive-minus-negative margin, margin<0, margin<0.5, and exact ties; p10 is the inverse empirical CDF over users. These two-candidate statistics are not HR@10. The 0.5 cutoff is descriptive, not calibrated.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:margin_delta: Perturbed minus intact margin for identical target and negative; draws averaged within user before averaging users.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:ordering_flip: Fraction of user/draw pairs for which margin>0 changes truth value. Exact ties are nonpositive and reported separately.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:feature_cosine_distance: 1-cosine between intact and perturbed final features; zero-norm pairs excluded. eligible_users reports metric-specific coverage.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:deletion: For n>=2 remove min(n-1,max(1,floor(0.25*n))) newest, oldest, or uniformly sampled positions. Compact survivors in order. Content, context, and absolute positions can change together; persisted deletion indices refer to retained-prefix positions.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:shuffle: Permute nonpadding IDs only, preserving multiplicities, targets and candidate IDs. Timestamp slots stay fixed. keep_latest excludes the newest slot from both swap roles.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:availability_shuffle: Window-restricted adaptation: minima computed over complete public training histories. Freeze all occurrences at their item's minimum timestamp, including ties. Scan unfrozen slots chronologically and uniformly choose feasible unfrozen partners j>=i with both swapped items available at destination times. Self-swaps allowed. Not a reproduction of complete-history author shuffling; training minima approximate availability, not release dates.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:swap_statistics: Displacement is fraction of original slots with changed item ID; repeated IDs can hide swaps. eligible_partner_mean averages feasible partner counts over attempted slots. nonself_swap_rate divides nonself swaps by attempted slots. No attempted slots gives null, not zero. Deletion displacement is undefined.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:uncertainty: 1000 seed-42 user-cluster percentile bootstrap replicates of user-averaged measurements when >=20 eligible users. Conditional on fixed panel, candidates and fitted model; excludes training seed variation and search bias. No cross-checkpoint trajectory comparison or calibrated health threshold is claimed.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:aggregation: This result is per dataset. aggregate_diagnoses requires all four named datasets and computes equal-weight macro means only where all four provide a measurement; it does not pool users or p10 values.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:unavailable: Null plus reason denotes empty or unsupported evidence. Item categories, ratings, prices, stores, review text and simulator traits are unavailable and unused. No larger-candidate ranks, top-10 overlaps, full-catalog quality or simulator conclusions are measured.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:state_isolation: Active loader is never iterated or inspected. Panel and permutations are persisted independently; local RNGs only. Global RNGs, explicit generators in view/model fields and standard containers, heterogeneous module modes and registered buffers are protected. Buffer mutation is restored and rejected. Identical intervention batches reuse measurements within a checkpoint, requiring deterministic eval forwards. Arbitrary Python-side mutations, custom stochastic eval behavior and generators hidden inside arbitrary objects are outside this adapter's guarantee.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:verification_limit: Enabled-versus-disabled subsequent optimizer-step equivalence has not been empirically tested here. No training or validation improvement is claimed. Diagnostic calls are host scheduled; no checkpoint-trajectory inference is made.
